<thought>The exact monoisotopic mass from the mass spectrum (224.120115) matches the formula C₁₆H₁₆O. A simple structure that fits this formula and is chemically reasonable is diphenyl‑methanol, where a central carbon bearing a hydroxyl group is attached to two phenyl rings. Its SMILES is “C(C)(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2”. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the required molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C(C)(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2</final_answer>
